project_name: CardPulse AI - WhatsApp B2B Contact Intelligence & Business Card SaaS
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ELECTRIC ACCENTS (Tactical Precision & Speed)

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Internal padding p-6 to p-8 for cards to avoid border edge collisions.
layout_strategy.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism header backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50
layout_strategy.bento_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B) for dashboard metrics & Tetris Grid (Mode A) for landing page feature highlights

key_features_to_implement.name: SaaS Marketing Landing Page
elements: Hero section with dynamic scanning animation mockup & CTA 'Start 14-Day Free Trial'
Live Interactive WA Scanner Simulator widget on landing page
Key Benefits grid: Auto Extraction, WhatsApp Instant Notification, AI Voice/Text Query Search
Pricing Tier Cards (Starter, Pro, Enterprise with monthly/annual toggle)
Trust Badges & Testimonial cards

key_features_to_implement.name: Organisation Onboarding & Registration
elements: Organisation Name, GSTIN number (with auto-verify validation format), Address, Admin Mobile No, Admin Email, Password
Instant mock WhatsApp Welcome Notification toast + preview message drawer

key_features_to_implement.name: Analytics & Command Dashboard
elements: KPI Cards: Total Contacts, Scanned via WA, Scanned via Panel, AI Extraction Accuracy Rate (%), Pending Review
Recent Activity feed with realtime status tags (WA Inbound / Manual Upload / Voice Query)
Quick Action Bar: Upload Cards, Invite Team Member, Test WA Query Simulator

key_features_to_implement.name: Bulk Card Scanner & Extraction Studio
elements: Drag & Drop zone supporting multiple images (JPG/PNG) & PDF files or Live Camera View simulation
AI Parsing loader state with OCR bounding boxes preview
Extraction Verification Drawer/Table: Company Name, Address, Contact Person, Email, Mobile, Designation, Confidence Score
One-click 'Save to Organisation DB' & trigger WA notification dispatch to contact

key_features_to_implement.name: Contacts Directory & Intelligence Hub
elements: Search & multi-filter by added-by member, source (WA vs Panel), designation, city/state
Table view with avatar, contact details, added by user badge, original card image preview modal
Detail Slide-over Drawer: Full extracted fields, AI Summary, WhatsApp conversation history, export VCard / CSV button

key_features_to_implement.name: Team Members & Access Control
elements: Add team member modal: Full Name, Role (Admin/Member/Sales Rep), Registered WhatsApp Mobile Number
Status indicators (Active / Pending WA Verification)
Individual team member scan contribution stats

key_features_to_implement.name: WhatsApp AI Query Test Bench
elements: Interactive Chat Simulator: User types or simulates sending Voice Note ('Send me details of Solar Manufacturers in Gujarat')
Real-time simulated AI response parsing DB and replying with VCards/Contact text formatted for WhatsApp

key_features_to_implement.name: WhatsApp Cloud API & Activity Logs
elements: Webhook status toggle, API Key / Phone Number ID inputs, Auto-responder message template editor with variables like {{contact_name}}, {{org_name}}, {{vcard_link}}
Inbound & Outbound message activity audit table

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is sleek (#0B0F17 background, slate-900/80 cards, emerald-500 accents).
Integrate Lucide Icons for high-fidelity UI elements.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for instant WhatsApp delivery confirmations and data extraction feedback.
Provide seamless mock data pre-populated with realistic Indian business profiles and GSTIN numbers.
Ensure responsive bento-grid layouts for dashboard metrics.
